invariant_evidence: Pre-dispatch success atomically transitions AUTHORIZED to DISPATCH_CLAIMED and persists the exact Decision, Mission, Tool, Adapter, approval and idempotency binding before the one allowed submit attempt.
Restart from DISPATCH_CLAIMED performs reconciliation only, while Secret injection and result collection require their distinct current repository-backed authorities.

SecretStore has no plaintext-returning application resolve path; the broker loads a current unconsumed Dispatch Claim, selects only the fixed Adapter channel, zeroes its temporary bytearray and durably consumes the Claim.
Caller Receipt, QuarantineReference, legacy loader and full-object publication paths are denied; only repository-bound ingestion_id execution may open committed chunks inside the redaction pipeline.
Audit Head and Wrapped Key State can use the shared content-bound generation coordinator with separate namespaces, immutable blob IDs, complete anchor CAS and exact read-back verification.
Missing or corrupt committed blobs fail closed, while key and audit state recover from the external blob after replacement of the non-authoritative local path.

The repository-bound coordinator read-back verifies SecureIngestionManifest before creating its manifest-bound QuarantineDeletionIntent and advances INGESTED_DURABLE, DELETE_PENDING and QUARANTINE_ERASED through paired OCC transitions.

Restart reuses immutable manifest and deletion evidence, resumes key destruction/unlink idempotently, and persists ExecutionResult before the final SUCCEEDED acknowledgement without replaying provider submit.
Executor persists collection_started_at and retention_until once at result collection, caps retention at the exact Mission deadline, and restart reuses the same authority.
The authority binds the exact ToolRef, Registry digest, Provider task and deterministic sink, and max_result_bytes is the minimum of that ToolDefinition limit and the system hard cap.
The application coordinator accepts only ingestion_id and loads the canonical Receipt, Execution, Result Collection Authority, Mission and quarantine stream from trusted repositories.
Strict immutable Dispatch Claim, collection authority, manifest, deletion-intent and generation-anchor models reject unknown fields, coercion and digest/row binding changes.
The Phase 0B isolated Mock ingester remains an exact test-double exception while non-mock ingestion requires the durable Phase 0C erasure state machine.
Phase 0B flow/safety regressions and Phase 0C positive, denial, crash, restart, retention, path-replacement and corrupt-blob cases remain covered.

notes: This audit is rebound to the dedicated current-HEAD design-approved implementation request. It covers the six retained P1 findings as one durable lifecycle redesign: post-validation Dispatch Claim, fixed-channel JIT Secret injection, exact result collection authority, ingestion_id-only secure ingestion, manifest-before-erasure recovery states, and shared digest/blob-bound generation coordination. No external provider or target action is introduced.
